description.text:
The first set of the Sun & Moon series and of the seventh generation, released on 3 February 2017 with 163 cards: 149 and 14 secret rares. It brought in Pokémon-GX, which work much like Pokémon-EX but each carry a GX attack, and a player may use only one GX attack a game. With Rowlet, Litten and Popplio, Solgaleo-GX and Lunala-GX, it has more than 40 new Pokémon from Alola and the first cards of Alolan forms of older Pokémon, such as Alolan Meowth and Alolan Diglett.

Its 14 secret rares were the most in any English set to then, and began the series' pattern of large sets heavy with them: Rainbow Rare versions of Pokémon-GX, in rainbow-colored full art, secret-rare Trainers and the first secret-rare basic Energy.

description.text: The Champion copy of Ultra Ball from the Europe International Championships of the 2018 season, given to the winner of each division. The reverse holo card carries the event stamp and a gold foil "Champion" stamp. Ultra Ball followed the Evolutions Double Colorless Energy as the second International Championships promo. Each International Championships promo came as a plain copy for every competitor, a Staff copy, and Top 8 and Champion copies for the top finishers.
